nodes.description: MALT1 is a cysteine protease that cleaves negative regulators of NF-kappaB and mRNA-destabilising proteins. In one protease-dead knock-in mouse line the protease was largely dispensable for crossing the lymphocyte activation threshold but essential for regulatory T cell development, which is how one gene produces both immunodeficiency and immune dysregulation. A second protease-deficient line showed reduced T cell proliferation, IL-2 production and Th17 differentiation in vitro, so the protease also contributes to effector T cell responses.
